data.body: Operator decision (2026-08-17): accepted the recommendation to treat this as an evaluation/oracle-policy issue, not a completion-verifier product defect. Evidence from two live Bedrock runs showed every trial reached PASS and all criteria were banked; only the timing/distribution preference (_bounded_bank_gaps expecting incremental gaps) failed. Dense successful banking is valid behavior. No prompt/runtime change is warranted; the evaluation should not require incremental banking when the final evidence state is complete.
